hypothesis: The recurrent HOLD bottleneck is partly caused by the one-step next-event target. A fixed five-executable-event remaining-option target should be materially more learnable from the same causal state information.
frozen: no recurrent trading-policy replay in Request219

target.name: five_event_remaining_option_upper_bound
target.definition: For each state, take the best BASE exit return among the next five actually observed executable POSITION states and subtract BASE EXIT-now.
target.warning: This is deliberately a hindsight upper-bound diagnostic to test learnability of remaining opportunity. It must not be treated as an oracle trading rule.
